name: Acceptance suite-3 test 85 - a wildcard in an aws:PrincipalArn condition value is not a partial Principal wildcard
note: IAM-1004 (Phase 10) Campaign D: Principal "*" narrowed by an ArnLike aws:PrincipalArn condition whose VALUE contains a wildcard (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deployment/*). A wildcard in a CONDITION value is a different, valid construct and must NEVER be mis-flagged as an invalid partial Principal-element wildcard. This document is a resource-based policy (every statement names a Principal), which this analyzer does not yet model, so it fails closed with UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_FAMILY - the condition wildcard is left untouched, and the bucket is not called anonymous/public without accounting for the condition. (Resource-policy family is the deferred later tranche.)
